Messages.Body:
Hi all !

I'm glad to present you the Red Pages : http://redpages.free.fr !

This website will show the face and the name of any VTES player that
wants to. You can also add few details about you (nickname, title,
email, website) usefull to anyone who want to know and contact you.

It's such a pity to meet nice players during big tournaments and
then forgot their names and email (due to the 'after-tourney' ? ;->).
You will also be able to see the face of the (foreign) players you are
speeking to ! Well, I think it can be usefull...

For the moment, there is only few french players (and a strange
slidesliper) on this page but I hope to have more and more pix to add
during the next weeks.
Feel free to send me yours !

Have nice games !
Baron2ni

PS : I know it's a bit...red. :->
